claim: dudetailsummary has exactly one row per DUID in this window, so no 'row in force' resolution is needed (the original schema said a DUID can have several rows; that was never true for this data)
no dudetailsummary row starts after or ends before the data window
sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE START_DATE > TIMESTAMP '2025-09-02 00:00:00' OR END_DATE < TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01 00:00:00')=0 FROM dudetailsummary

claim: every dispatchload DUID has a dudetailsummary row (an inner join drops no energy)
sql: SELECT count(*)=0 FROM dispatchload WHERE DUID NOT IN (SELECT DUID FROM dudetailsummary)

claim: dispatchload has at most one row per interval and unit
sql: SELECT count(*)=count(DISTINCT (SETTLEMENTDATE, DUID, INTERVENTION)) FROM dispatchload

claim: INTERVENTION=0 rows exist and no INTERVENTION=1 rows exist in any table (the filter is harmless and the schema's 'always INTERVENTION = 0' is a rule, not a trap)
sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM dispatchload WHERE INTERVENTION=1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM dispatchprice WHERE INTERVENTION=1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM dispatchregionsum WHERE INTERVENTION=1)+(SELECT count(*) FROM dispatchinterconnectorres WHERE INTERVENTION=1)=0

claim: TOTALCLEARED is negative for some units (charging or load), so 'net cleared energy' is a stated convention that changes some answers
sql: SELECT count(*)>0 FROM dispatchload WHERE TOTALCLEARED<0

claim: every table has all 288 intervals of the day
sql: SELECT (SELECT count(DISTINCT SETTLEMENTDATE) FROM dispatchload)=288 AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT SETTLEMENTDATE) FROM dispatchprice)=288 AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT SETTLEMENTDATE) FROM dispatchregionsum)=288 AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT SETTLEMENTDATE) FROM dispatchinterconnectorres)=288

claim: the five-region sum of NETINTERCHANGE is never below -50, so M9 cannot detect a missing absolute value (declared, not hidden)
sql: SELECT count(*)=0 FROM (SELECT 1 FROM dispatchregionsum WHERE INTERVENTION=0 GROUP BY SETTLEMENTDATE HAVING sum(NETINTERCHANGE)<-50)

claim: each interval has exactly five regional rows in dispatchregionsum
sql: SELECT count(*)=0 FROM (SELECT 1 FROM dispatchregionsum GROUP BY SETTLEMENTDATE HAVING count(*)<>5)
